verdict.rationale: Lambda's Managed Slurm offering is the only first-party mechanism here: it automatically schedules submitted workloads so batch jobs run unattended on the cluster, and Lambda maintains the Slurm daemons. Nothing shows a native automation feature such as scheduled or triggered workflows or autonomous agents. The unofficial community MCP/CLI tool, the API, and cloud-init are user-built or building-block approaches and earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party scheduled or triggered automations, event-driven background workflows outside Slurm clusters, built-in lifecycle automation such as auto-stop, and independent corroboration.
